verdict.rationale: Lium's first-party docs say an agent can do everything with no browser. The official CLI supports non-interactive flags, `lium exec` propagates the remote command's exit code for scripting, and scoped API keys carry server-enforced budgets, which together cover headless automation. Missing for 10: an explicit CI-pipeline integration guide or example (e.g. a CI workflow), independent hands-on corroboration of headless runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: An agent can do everything on Lium with no browser: sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods.
lium exec job "nvidia-smi"                              # exits with the remote command's exit code
API keys with scopes and per-key daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets enforced by the server
The SDK rents the cheapest matching node, runs the function there, returns the result and removes the pod (or keeps it warm).
